text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(...I gave the race everything I presently
have,
and the results will be a nice
launching point for
the Japanese Derby.
And yet...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(This indescribable haze deep down
inside...
Whatever could it be?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Just what is going on with me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(The Japanese Derby is right around the
corner...
and yet!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although Mejiro Ardan performed
brilliantly at
the Aoba Sho, she doesn't
seem as elated as I
would've expected.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, Trainer... At long last,
the
Japanese Derby is almost upon us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I shall learn from this experience and
expend
even more effort in the little
time we have left. As
such, I humbly
request your continued assistance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At first glance, Mejiro Ardan looks the
same as
always—just fine. But...
something about her
seems off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day after the Aoba Sho...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(So many racers are going to be
participating in
the Japanese Derby, but
my thoughts keep
gravitating towards
Yaeno and Chiyono O in
particular...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Their recent races have shown that
they've
improved far more than I
believed possible.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(And I expect their performances at the
Derby
will be just as awe-inspiring.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I know them both so well... That's how I
know
they'll be great.)
